criteria.evidence: RemotePaymentGateway.kt:59-74 keeps mapNotNull over GET /packs with name and price from Play only; RemotePaymentGatewayPacksTest.threePacksOnlyFivePackAndNonePack covers 3, only-5 and none (characterization).

RemotePaymentGatewayPurchaseTest.purchasesEachPackAndRefusesUnlistedPack posts {productId,purchaseToken} once per pack with the 64-hex obfuscated id, and an unlisted id gets Failed with no Play launch (guard at RemotePaymentGateway.kt:117). Before packs() has run the guard does not apply, but GooglePlayBilling.kt:55-57 returns Failed when Play has no ProductDetails, so no billing flow opens. A forged id cannot reach the server without a Play token, and the server rejects unknown products (apps-backend purchases.ts:244). No finding.

PENDING goes to hold() with no POST (RemotePaymentGateway.kt:155). 409/502/IO keep the pack pending, retry twice inline, then make 5 background reposts at 2-32 s (lines 165-205). PurchaseSettleV2Test.pendingAndTransientServerErrorsKeepTokenAndRepost covers this. A token whose reposts all fail stays in Play and is re-posted by PurchaseRestorer at the next start. The server dedupes on the token hash (purchases.ts:246, 271) and acknowledges when consume fails (purchases.ts:109), so nothing is lost or granted twice inside Play's 3-day window.

PurchaseSettleV2Test.rejectionsFailWithoutGrantAndCancelIsSilent: 400/403 give Failed(PaymentUnconfirmed) with no pending and no repost, a Play failure gives PaymentUnavailable, and a cancel gives Cancelled. The device never adds credits: prod record() is a no-op (OfflineFirstCreditsRepository.kt:47-49) and unlock makes no request (RemotePaymentGateway.kt:132).

PurchaseRestorerPacksTest.restoresThreeTokensAndDropsForeignToken re-posts 3 tokens and drops the 403 one. The generation guard is unchanged (RemotePaymentGateway.kt:166, 183, 209), and the base tests for account-switch restore are kept.

WalletDto v2 (Wallet.kt) defaults credits to free+purchased and drops the deprecated fields. WalletDtoTest decodes both shapes. The server sets credits = free + purchased (wallet.ts:113), so the toEntitlement total matches.

TailorMyResumeApi.unlock, UnlockResponse, UnlockDto and CreditKind are removed. RemotePaymentGatewayUnlockTest.unlockMakesNoRequestInProd covers it. Adjudication of lead commit f9c93f5f: dropping the three unlock-route tests and the unlockedApplicationIds assertion is justified because the route and the field are gone (contract v2). The late-answer-after-sign-out pattern that one of those tests covered has no equivalent for the credits cache (see finding 2).

RemoteCreditsLedgerSource.kt maps WELCOME->FREE_GRANT, PURCHASE, TAILORING->SPEND, REFUND and MIGRATION, and skips UNKNOWN. RemoteLedgerSourceTest.mapsKindsNewestFirstAndSkipsUnknown covers it. The DTO matches the server GET /credits shape (routes.ts:61-86).
balanceIsWalletCreditsNotRowSum proves this within one repository instance. In the app the class is unscoped (finding 1), so a consumer that did not run refresh() itself sees 0.

The device never double-counts: prod record() is a no-op, the server writes TAILORING (wallet.ts:159-176), and a D56 run-<runId> SPEND marker is never written in prod. No refresh follows a spend or a purchase, though, so the balance never drops by 1 in-process (finding 3).

Refresh failure keeps values, and a late answer for another owner is dropped (OfflineFirstCreditsRepository.kt:63). Sign-out (SignOutCleaner.kt:19-25) does not clear the credits cache, and the owner filter only re-runs when `held` emits (finding 2). clear() still wipes credit_ledger (D34).

The demo binds NoRemoteLedger, and OfflinePaymentGateway is unchanged. DemoCreditsSeamTest asserts the binding and that BillingClient and TailorMyResumeApi are absent from the demo classpath. RemoteLedgerSource lives in core:data and has no network import.

There is no Log, Timber or println under billing/ or credits/. BillingNoSensitiveLoggingTest scans both roots for logging calls and for sensitive words in error, check, require and Exception messages (single-line scan).

At f9c93f5f, CI unit, lint, screenshot and static checks pass. Assemble APKs was still pending and delivery-gates-pregate was failing at review time. The PR body states verify-local.sh is green; I did not re-run dependencyGuard.

findings.rule: 287-c9/c11; the prod ledger cache must be one per process, like the other stateful repositories in core/data (StoredSessionRepository, StoredResumeSettingsRepository and others are @Singleton)
findings.trigger: The diff adds in-memory state to OfflineFirstCreditsRepository (held, generation, refreshCancelled at lines 24-29), but the class has no @Singleton and the @Binds at DataModule.kt:59 is unscoped, so Hilt creates a new instance for every injection. Prod case: #315 AppViewModel calls creditsRepository.refresh() after sign-in on its own instance. CollectAccountDataUseCase (line 32) then calls observeLedger().first() on a different instance, whose held is null, so the account-data archive gets an empty credit ledger. A Credits-screen ViewModel (#284) and TailoringRunner (#317) also get fresh instances and see balance 0 and no entries, even though the user has bought credits. clear() from DeleteAccountUseCase only bumps the generation of its own instance.
findings.title: The prod credit snapshot lives in an unscoped repository, so each consumer sees its own empty cache
findings.proof: Add a Hilt prod test that injects CreditsRepository into two holders, calls refresh() on one with MockWebServer answering GET /credits balance 7, and asserts observeBalance().first() == 7 on the other. It fails at head (0) and passes once @Singleton is added to OfflineFirstCreditsRepository.

findings.rule: 287-c11: on sign-out or an account switch the prod ledger cache is cleared and the old account's values are never shown
findings.trigger: SignOutCleaner.kt:19-25 clears payments, analysis, reports and the store, but never calls CreditsRepository.clear(), so held keeps user A's balance and ledger (application ids, product ids) after sign-out. The owner filter at line 32 reads remote.owner() inside held.map, so it only re-runs when held emits. A collector that subscribed while A was signed in (for example a stateIn(WhileSubscribed(5_000)) ViewModel that survives the switch) keeps showing A's balance and ledger to user B until B's refresh lands. If B's refresh fails, it keeps showing them indefinitely, because a failed refresh keeps the last values. The new test (OfflineFirstCreditsRepositoryRemoteTest.kt:108-113) only uses fresh first() subscriptions. It would still pass with the guard at line 63 removed, because the late answer is tagged with the captured uid-1 and hidden by the read-side filter. So nothing replaces the removed anUnlockAnsweredAfterSignOutDoesNotRestoreTheOldWallet coverage.
findings.title: Sign-out does not clear the prod credits cache, and a live collector keeps the old account's ledger
findings.proof: Collect observeBalance() into a list with backgroundScope, refresh() as uid-1 (balance 7), switch the owner to uid-2 with fetch failing, call refresh(), and assert the last emitted value is 0. It fails at head (the collector still holds 7). Also add a SignOutCleaner test asserting that the credits cache is cleared.

findings.rule: 287-c10: after a successful prod tailoring the balance drops by exactly 1, and after a purchase it shows the server balance (balance only from the server)
findings.trigger: In prod, record() (lines 47-49) now does nothing and triggers no refresh. Before this diff the prod Room flow updated on record. No production code calls CreditsRepository.refresh() after a spend or a purchase; the only caller is #315 AppViewModel on an account change. Example: sign-in refresh shows balance 1. A tailoring succeeds and the server debits to 0. TailoringCreditSpend.forSuccess calls record(), which is a no-op, and observeBalance keeps emitting 1 until the process restarts or the account changes, so the next tap gets a server 402. Likewise, after PurchaseResult.Completed for the 40 pack (RemotePaymentGateway.kt:207-213 updates only WalletSource), the Credits balance and ledger stay at the pre-purchase values.
findings.title: The prod record() no-op triggers no refresh, so the credits balance goes stale after every spend and purchase
findings.proof: With ScriptedRemote returning balance 6 and then 5, call refresh() and then record(SPEND), and assert observeBalance().first() == 5 without calling refresh() explicitly. It fails at head (6).
